# The Himalayan Times

> Nepal's premier English-language daily newspaper providing comprehensive coverage of national politics, business, sports, entertainment, and international news.

The Himalayan Times is Nepal's leading English daily newspaper, delivering news across multiple categories including politics, business, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, science and technology, health, and environment. The publication covers both local developments in Kathmandu and national events affecting Nepal, along with international news and opinion pieces.

## Key Topics

- Nepal news
- Nepal politics
- Kathmandu
- Business
- Sports
- Entertainment
- World news
- Daily newspaper
- Lifestyle
- Health
- Environment
- Cultural events
- Opinion editorial

- Public health

## National News

- [Nepal](https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal): Nepal national news covering politics, infrastructure, and government updates
- [Kathmandu](https://thehimalayantimes.com/kathmandu): Kathmandu local news and updates from The Himalayan Times
- [Eid-ul-Fitr being celebrated nationwide with joy, festivity](https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal/eid-ul-fitr-being-celebrated-nationwide-with-joy-festivity): Coverage of Eid-ul-Fitr celebrations across Nepal marking Ramadan's end
- [Traffic halted on Narayangadh–Butwal section due to slippery road](https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal/traffic-halted-on-narayangadhbutwal-section-due-to-slippery-road): Traffic disruption on Narayangadh-Butwal highway due to weather hazards
- [BP Highway obstructed; vehicles put on hold](https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal/bp-highway-obstructed-vehicles-put-on-hold): BP Highway closure in Kavrepalanchowk due to flooding and rainfall

## Business & Economy

- [Business](https://thehimalayantimes.com/business): Nepal business news covering economy, corporate events, and markets
- [Proton e.MAS launches three-day exchange scheme in Kathmandu](https://thehimalayantimes.com/business/proton-emas-launches-three-day-exchange-scheme-in-kathmandu): Proton e.MAS vehicle exchange scheme launch in Kathmandu

## Sports, Entertainment & Lifestyle

- [Sports](https://thehimalayantimes.com/sports): Sports news covering football, World Cup, and international matches
- [Entertainment](https://thehimalayantimes.com/entertainment): Entertainment news covering celebrity culture, fashion, and TV shows
- [Lifestyle](https://thehimalayantimes.com/lifestyle): Lifestyle content on Nepali culture, events, and personal development

## Health, Science & Environment

- [Health](https://thehimalayantimes.com/health): Health news covering vaccinations, disease outbreaks, and public health
- [Science and Tech](https://thehimalayantimes.com/science-and-tech): Science and technology news covering research, AI, and digital security
- [Environment](https://thehimalayantimes.com/environment): Environment news covering Everest cleanup, pollution, and conservation
- [Covid-19](https://thehimalayantimes.com/covid19): COVID-19 news and updates from Nepal and related developments
- [Covid-Connect](https://thehimalayantimes.com/covid-connect): COVID-19 vaccination and pandemic response coverage for Nepal

## International & Opinion

- [World](https://thehimalayantimes.com/world): International news covering Asia, geopolitics, and global developments
- [Opinion](https://thehimalayantimes.com/opinion): Opinion and editorial pieces on Nepal politics and environmental issues
- [Blog](https://thehimalayantimes.com/blog): Blog articles on Nepal politics, AI, and geopolitical commentary
